description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales 

Are delighted to present No. 51 College Green to the market this outstanding four-bedroom family residence situated in one of the area’s most sought-after residential communities. 

With an impressive floor area of approximately 132 sq. m., this exceptionally spacious home is considerably larger than the standard semi-detached property.

Owner-occupied, beautifully maintained and thoughtfully upgraded by its current owners this home is also highly energy efficient with very impressive BER of B2. Electricity generating PV solar panels have also been recently fitted which have resulted in substantial savings.

 the property occupies an superior position at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. With no passing traffic and views across a well-maintained green, this is an ideal setting for families with young children.

On arrival, you are greeted by a tastefully presented brick-paved driveway providing ample off-street parking for two cars, complemented by beautifully planted shrubs and mature trees.

Internally, a generous double-width entrance hallway featuring premium natural wood flooring sets the tone for the quality of accommodation throughout. The hallway leads into an exceptionally spacious living room, complete with bespoke wall panelling, a feature fireplace and a large window overlooking the green to the front.

To the rear lies the outstanding kitchen and dining area. The fully upgraded kitchen features contemporary units and crisp white countertops, while the light-filled dining space benefits from an oversized picture frame window overlooking the rear garden. A generously proportioned utility room and a beautifully presented guest WC complete the ground-floor accommodation.

Outside, the private rear garden features an extensive paved patio, mature trees and a paved pathway leading to additional storage, providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and family life.

The staircase is beautifully finished with classical wood panelling, a tasteful two-tone colour scheme and an elegant central carpet runner.

Upstairs, a spacious landing provides access to four beautifully appointed bedrooms. The principal bedroom comes complete with built-in sliding wardrobes, custom-made window shutters and a stylish en-suite bathroom.

A further generous double bedroom is positioned to the rear of the property and features contemporary flooring, built-in wardrobes and pleasant views over the garden. To the front are two additional well-presented bedrooms, one of which is currently arranged as a home office. A beautifully finished family bathroom completes the accommodation.

If you are searching for an exceptionally spacious, comprehensively upgraded and superior family home within a highly regarded residential community, then look no further than No. 51 College Green as it is certain to meet all your wish-list requirements.

If this sounds like the home you have been waiting for, we would be delighted to hear from you and assist you in any way we can.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, your trusted experts in residential property sales.
